question: Will the Dallas Cowboys win the 2027 NFL league championship?
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2027 NFL league championship. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2027 NFL league championship per the rules of the NFL (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2027 NFL league championship game is cancelled, postponed after March 31, 2027 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Los Angeles Rams lead the 2027 NFL champion market at 16.5% implied probability due to an aggressive 2026 offseason that added edge rusher Myles Garrett, cornerbacks Trent McDuffie and Jaylen Watson, and the return of Aaron Donald, complementing reigning MVP Matthew Stafford and a high-powered offense featuring Puka Nacua and Davante Adams under Sean McVay. The Buffalo Bills and Denver Broncos follow at roughly 8% each on the strength of their quarterback play and defensive foundations in a competitive AFC, while the defending champion Seattle Seahawks sit at 6.5% amid roster continuity and a turnover-forcing defense. A wide field reflects the inherent uncertainty of a full season, with injuries, depth, and late-season form serving as primary variables that could shift outcomes among the top contenders.
